chapter.chapter: Chapter 4 — The Theory of the Firm under Perfect Competition

excerpts:
[CBSE Class XII Economics, sample question paper, 2022-23]
11. Suppose in a hypothetical economy there are only two Firms A and B, Firm A sold goods
for ₹ 2,000 to Firm B and purchased goods for ₹ 1,000. Firm B exported goods for ₹ 2,500 3
and had domestic sales of ₹ 1,500. Calculate Net Domestic Product at market price, if
consumption of fixed capital is ₹ 200.

[CBSE Class XII Economics, marking scheme, 2025-26]
11. Gross Value Added of Firm B = (i) – (iv) ½
= 1,000 – 250 = ₹ 750 crore ½
Gross Value Added of Firm A = Gross Value Added of Firm B = ₹ 750 crore
Domestic Sales of Firm A = Gross Value Added of Firm A – (iii) – (v) + (ii) 1
= 750 – 200 – 150 + 300 ½
= ₹ 700 crore ½

[CBSE Class XII Economics, marking scheme, 2026-27]
10. (C) 1, infinity 1
11 A Value-Added Method:
Gross Domestic Product at Market Price = (ii) - (viii) ½
= 1,900 – 330 ½
= ₹ 1,570 crore ½
Expenditure Method:
Gross Domestic Product at Market Price = (i) + (iii) + (iv) + (vii) ½
= 500 + 400 + 600 + 70 ½
= ₹ 1,570 crore ½
OR
11 B (I) Two factors of production and their respective remunerations earned are:
• Land - Rent ½ + ½
• Capital - Interest ½ + ½
(II) The remuneration earned by the Land can be defined as:
Rent: Income earned by the owner of the land (natural resources). 1

[CBSE Class XII Economics, marking scheme, 2024-25]
